backend/main.mo: Defines actor types for users, rituals, love languages, challenges, storage, and authorization, serving as the backend's core data model. Includes mixins for access control and blob storage.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence records mapping features to affected files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides short summaries of various frontend source files describing their purpose, UI behavior, and configuration.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind-based CSS variables for light and dark themes and applies base styling to body and elements.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting metadata, icons, theme-color, and a pre-React theme initialization script before loading the app.
frontend/QA_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md: Manual QA checklist detailing verification steps for versioning, theming, rituals, authentication, and pairing behaviors.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling authentication, profile loading, navigation between tabs, and switching between landing, login, and app modes.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar that displays tab icons and labels and triggers tab changes.
frontend/src/components/CompletionAnimat: Generates floating animated heart icons for a celebratory completion effect.
frontend/src/components/DataStates.tsx: UI components for loading, empty, error, section headers, and inline loading states.
frontend/src/components/HarmonyBreakdown: Card showing current harmony score, trend visualization, and explanations based on backend data.
Compact harmony summary button showing score and trend, linking to insights.
frontend/src/components/LandingBrand.tsx: Brand logo component with image fallback and compact/full variants.
frontend/src/components/LandingFooterLin: Dialog component rendering about/contact/terms/privacy/investor content based on selected footer link.
frontend/src/components/LandingHeroScree: Displays a phone mockup cycling through screenshots with dot-based navigation.
Shows truncated or full founder story text with a toggle to expand or collapse.
frontend/src/components/LandingScreensho: Implements an auto-advancing screenshot carousel with captions and manual controls.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Provides a login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading and error handling.
frontend/src/components/LoveChallenges.t: Static card announcing upcoming love challenge features.
frontend/src/components/OurLoveLanguages: Card showing love languages status with primary action and insights shortcut.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Form for initializing a user profile with name input, validation, and success state.
frontend/src/components/RewardVisuals.ts: Displays placeholder progress and milestone visuals for user challenge progress.
frontend/src/components/SpinWheel.tsx: Interactive spinning wheel selecting a random love language with daily spin tracking.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: Renders a button that toggles between light and dark themes using useTheme and displays a sun or moon icon.
frontend/src/components/UnlockPacks.tsx: Defines unlockable love‑language activity packs and a component for selecting and viewing them based on streak and quiz results.
frontend/src/content/contact.ts: Exports the app’s contact email address.
frontend/src/content/founderStory.ts: Exports a long text narrative describing the origin story of GrowInLove.
frontend/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx: Provides a theme context with light/dark/system support, syncing to localStorage and system preferences.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the user’s identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity auth provider and hook for login, logout, and managing identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Returns whether the user prefers reduced motion based on a media query listener.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps many backend calls with react-query hooks for profiles, admin checks, rituals, and pairing logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useSectionEntrance.ts: Uses IntersectionObserver to detect when a section enters view and supports reduced‑motion preference.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Re‑exports the useTheme hook from ThemeContext for compatibility.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, extensive CSS variables for light/dark romantic theme, utility classes, and animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider and mounts the App component.
frontend/src/pages/Activities.tsx: Displays love activities, gates access based on authentication and pairing, and renders challenges, rewards, and a spin wheel.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Handles daily ritual flow including fetching rituals, submitting responses, viewing history, and showing animations and media uploads.
frontend/src/pages/Insights.tsx: Shows relationship insights such as streaks, harmony metrics, milestones, and trends based on backend analytics.
frontend/src/pages/Landing.tsx: Renders a marketing landing page with hero, features, story sections, animations, and app entry controls.
frontend/src/pages/LoveLanguages.tsx: Implements a full love languages quiz flow with question rendering, UI mappings, scoring, and saving/resetting results using backend hooks.
frontend/src/pages/Memories.tsx: Displays a list of ritual memory entries with expandable details, love‑language tagging, date formatting, and photo‑enabled responses.
frontend/src/pages/Us.tsx: Manages user pairing, profile state, admin checks, and shared love‑language insights with UI for generating and completing pairing codes.
frontend/src/utils/harmony.ts: Provides helpers for converting harmony values to percentages, normalizing 7‑day trend data, and generating trend labels and display metadata.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, clearing, and syncing URL parameters with sessionStorage, including hash‑route support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, animations, and layout utilities for the frontend UI.
project_state.json: Defines project state metadata, deployment issues, and a list of landing‑page UI/UX fix features with associated requirement IDs and versions.
